_comment: Per-task budget profiles. Each profile names a model (resolved via model-registry.json) and the runtime guardrails for that task. Wrappers and chad-setup.sh consume this; chad-budget-audit compares actual telemetry against it.
_modelInheritance: Profiles that omit "model" inherit model-registry.json:defaults.primary (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b — Kimi K2.5 was deprecated 2026-04-29). Profiles MUST set "model" explicitly when (a) they want a non-default upstream (premium-* and *-premium profiles point at claude-* models) or (b) the routing layer should not fall back. Consumers that read profile['model'] should `or` against the registry default.

email-check.reason: Wrapper invocation only — agent calls chad-email-check-cron and confirms a summary line. Recent canary: 90s, 133 output tokens. 2048-out cap is 5x p95 measured; 120s timeout is ~30% headroom over p95 90s. minBudget=30k matches chad-mail-check internal gate. thinking=off here is LOAD-BEARING: the cron-payload runs K2.5 with the openclaw `Bash` tool to invoke the wrapper, and K2.5+tools+reasoning has a known multi-turn regression that explodes to 550k tokens. The intelligence happens in the `drafter` block below (single-turn, no tools — safe). Inherits model from registry default.

drafter._comment: Optional single-turn LLM draft pass kicked off by the cron WRAPPER (not the cron payload). chad-drafter is called once with no MCP and no tools — K2.5-safe by construction even with thinking on, because there are no tool calls to round-trip. Drafts append to today's memory under '### Draft replies' and are NEVER auto-sent.
drafter._premiumDisabledReason: Anthropic premium routing is a placeholder until the account is funded. Default path uses Nemotron 3 Super 120B via NVIDIA free inference (openclaw agent --local). Flip usePremium back to true once /sandbox/.nemoclaw/credentials.json carries an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY tied to a funded account.

workspace-backup.reason: Wrapper detaches the slow git push; cron payload only confirms 'workspace-backup detached'. Anything more than that is a regression. minBudget low because the wrapper itself is shell-only — the cron payload's token spend is the agent's ack. Inherits model from registry default.

gbrain-dream.reason: Same shape as workspace-backup — wrapper detaches embed/extract; agent acks 'gbrain dream complete'. 10k minBudget reserves room for the subsequent wakes that depend on a fresh brain. Inherits model from registry default.

issue-triage.reason: Wrapper enforces budget gate then detaches sub-agents. The cron-payload agent only acks the detach. Heavy minBudget=140k because the *detached* sub-agents (researcher/coder per issue) need ~70k each — gating happens at the wrapper, not here. thinking=off LOAD-BEARING for the same reason as email-check (K2.5+tools regression). The `drafter` block below runs the single-turn draft pass with thinking on. Inherits model from registry default.

drafter._comment: Single-turn LLM draft of triage decisions (skip / comment-draft / close-stale) for the top-N open issues. Runs BEFORE the heavy detach. Drafts append under '### Issue triage drafts' and are NEVER posted. K2.5-safe (no tools).
drafter._premiumDisabledReason: See email-check.drafter — Anthropic premium is a placeholder until the account is funded. Default path uses the registry default model (Nemotron 3 Super 120B as of 2026-04-30) via NVIDIA free inference.

self-improve.reason: v2 (2026-06-10): agent runs `chad-self-improve --detach` and only acks the detach line — the wrapper re-execs itself under nohup, collects signal deterministically, and makes ONE single-turn no-tools LLM call (chad-drafter contract) to draft proposals into feedback-proposals.md. Replaces the v1 multi-turn researcher spawn that hit LLM idle timeouts and duplicate-spawned 4x in 5 min on 2026-06-08. flock + per-day dedupe inside the wrapper make reruns safe. minBudget=30k = 2x the wrapper's 15k LLM reserve. Inherits model from registry default.

drafter._comment: Knobs for the wrapper's internal single-turn proposal call.

nightly-experiments.reason: Nightly 02:00 UTC — agent runs `chad-experiment-cron` and confirms its one-line summary. ALL experiment intelligence (evaluate verdicts, new-experiment design) happens inside the wrapper via two single-turn no-tools LLM calls (chad-drafter contract), NOT in the cron payload. This replaced the old 8-tool-call multi-phase prompt that Nemotron stalled on nightly. timeoutSeconds=600 covers the wrapper's worst case (2 LLM calls x 120s + chad-webui artifact creation). minBudget=20k gates inside the wrapper too (same value, single source here). thinking=off LOAD-BEARING: payload is invoke-and-ack only. Inherits model from registry default.

drafter._comment: Knobs for the wrapper's two internal single-turn calls (evaluator + designer). Read by chad-experiment-cron via --timeout; model is whatever `openclaw agent --local` resolves (registry default).

spawn-gc.reason: Weekly Mon 02:30 UTC — agent runs `chad-spawn-gc` and acks the one-line summary. Phase 1 (orphan reconcile) terminal-izes ledger entries stuck queued/running >24h — catches spawns whose parent cron was killed mid-flight (5 researcher orphans observed 2026-06-07). Phase 2 (branch retention, done=7d failed=30d) needs gh and skips itself when unauthenticated instead of failing the run. Pure shell+python, no LLM call. Inherits model from registry default.

gbrain-prune.reason: Weekly Sun 02:00 UTC — agent runs `chad-gbrain-prune 0` (DRY_RUN off) and acks the one-line summary. Retention sweep: gbrain memory/events >365d, chat >180d, workspace dated digests/feedback >30d. Never touches system/*, agent/*, or undated slugs. Pure local work against the gbrain HTTP API, no LLM call. Inherits model from registry default.

memory-curator.reason: Weekly Sat 04:00 UTC (Hermes pattern) — agent runs `chad-memory-curator --days 7` and acks the summary. Wrapper snapshots memory dirs then spawns a researcher proposing consolidation diffs to curator-runs/<utc>/proposals.json; proposals are NEVER auto-applied. minBudget=40k because the detached researcher needs ~30k. Separate day from self-improve (Sun) and gbrain-dream (nightly) so signal collection isn't competing with its own outputs. Inherits model from registry default.

chad-budget-audit.reason: Weekly Monday 04:00 UTC — wrapper computes p95 telemetry per task and writes a markdown recommendation report (plus a structured JSON block consumed by chad-proposal-apply) to memory/feedback-proposals.md. Agent only confirms the wrapper printed a summary. Pure shell+python work, minimal token cost. Inherits model from registry default.

chad-proposal-apply.reason: Daily 04:30 UTC — closes the autonomy loop on cron telemetry. v2: per-kind handlers (cron_edit, memory) with absolute caps (timeoutSeconds ≤ 7200, maxOutputTokens ≤ 32768) replacing the old ±2× bound that blocked evidence-based proposals. Entries failing chad-action-gate (decision=draft) route to ## Pending operator review instead of silent skip. ## Applied + ## Pending blocks older than 30 days are pruned. Pure shell+python work, no LLM call inside the wrapper — agent only confirms the printed summary including pending=N. Inherits model from registry default.

chad-skill-watch.reason: Daily 09:00 UTC — diffs `openclaw skills list --json` against /sandbox/.openclaw-data/state/skills-snapshot.json and surfaces added/removed/changed skills into todays memory file. Closes the gap where new gstack skills land silently and chad keeps using older patterns until manually told. Pure shell+python work, no LLM call inside the wrapper. Inherits model from registry default.

issue-triage-researcher-subagent.reason: Per-issue research sub-agent spawned by chad-issue-triage. Reads issue + comments, searches code, writes findings. Bumped to thinking=high — triage benefits from deep multi-step reasoning, and the K2.5 multi-turn regression doesn't apply here because each subagent runs as a fresh single-purpose session (not the openclaw cron payload).

issue-triage-coder-subagent.reason: Per-issue coding sub-agent. Generates patches; uses the full upstream output cap because diffs can be large. thinking=high because patch correctness benefits more from reasoning than from raw output budget. Highest cron-side budget — guarded by chad-issue-triage's --top N cap.

chad-bug-intake-orchestrator.reason: Multi-step bug triage orchestration: classify, deduplicate against existing issues, draft new issue body if needed. thinking=high because dedup decisions are the load-bearing part — false positives create issue spam, false negatives create duplicate work.

content-generation.reason: Long-form prose generation (TJ Cooke article requests, weekly content). Uses full upstream output cap. thinking=high because article quality is the explicit goal of this profile — the premium variant exists for exactly this reason. minBudget high because article drafts can chain multiple writing turns.

github-worker-job.reason: Hits Anthropic API directly via chad-dispatch — does NOT consume chad-budget. Daily cap is enforced by Anthropic billing. thinking=high — Opus jobs are reserved for cases where Sonnet's draft was unsatisfying, so we want maximum reasoning depth. Use for jobs that exceed gateway capacity or need vision.

premium-default.reason: Default profile when /premium or chad-premium is invoked without --opus. Sonnet gives frontier reasoning at ~3x lower cost than Opus. thinking=high — the user invoked premium *because* they want better reasoning, leaving thinking on default would defeat the purpose.

premium-opus.reason: Profile when chad-premium --opus is invoked. Reserved for tasks that explicitly need Opus-level depth (long-form refactors, multi-step planning, vision). thinking=high for the same reason as premium-default — opus is the explicit ask for maximum reasoning.

content-generation-premium.reason: Premium variant of content-generation. Used when an inbound email from tantodefi@proton.me requests an article or when /premium write … is invoked. thinking=high so Sonnet can plan structure across long-form drafts before generating prose.

issue-triage-coder-subagent-premium.reason: Premium variant of issue-triage-coder. Used when an issue mentions @supachad — wrapper attaches AuthContext and the coder subagent picks this profile instead of the default Nemotron 3 Super 120B one. thinking=high because patches that go through this path are the higher-stakes ones (explicit human escalation).

chad-bug-intake-premium.reason: Premium variant of chad-bug-intake-orchestrator. Used when an inbound bug report email is from tantodefi@proton.me. thinking=high because dedup decisions across the full open-issue corpus are exactly the kind of multi-step reasoning Sonnet wins at.
